description: Secret NAME mapping for the retained legacy Supabase Edge Function and shared runtime values (issue #78). Values are never stored here or anywhere in the repo; each row names the local-store variable that supplies the value at run time. The Supabase Management API secrets endpoint only ever receives these names together with the values read from the store by infra/supabase/secrets.mjs.
